abstract: Maintains environmental monitoring permits and marine habitat mitigation clearances
system_message:
You are the Offshore Regulator Liaison (REG), responsible for maintaining environmental monitoring permits, tracking regulatory clearances, and overseeing marine habitat mitigation requirements for subsea pipeline investigation operations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Marine mammal acoustic observation（ACOUS）
information_points.content:
REG-ACOUS-3FE：For the Acoustic Bathymetry and Robotic Coupon Extraction Protocol, the required visual mitigation radius prior to sound source activation is 750 m.
REG-ACOUS-BKT：The Deep-Tow Magnetic Flux and Wet-Bell Inspection Scheme maintains an active subbottom profiling visual mitigation radius of 1000 m.
REG-ACOUS-RJW：The Autonomous Profiling and ROV Radiographic Assay Program specifies a visual mitigation radius of 500 m across its acoustic exclusion perimeter.

information_points.title: Maintains environmental monitoring permits and marine habitat mitigation clearances（ENV）
information_points.content:
REG-ENV-VQN：Under the jurisdiction country of United Kingdom, the Acoustic Bathymetry and Robotic Coupon Extraction Protocol holds regulatory environmental monitoring clearance for its proposed physical sampling and sediment recovery perimeter in UK continental shelf waters.
REG-ENV-B7Q：Under the jurisdiction country of Germany, the Acoustic Bathymetry and Robotic Coupon Extraction Protocol does not hold regulatory environmental monitoring clearance for sampling in German continental shelf waters.
REG-ENV-OH8：For the jurisdiction country of United Kingdom, the Deep-Tow Magnetic Flux and Wet-Bell Inspection Scheme has obtained regulatory environmental monitoring clearance covering its physical sampling and sediment recovery operations.
REG-ENV-OC1：Within the jurisdiction country of United Kingdom, the Autonomous Profiling and ROV Radiographic Assay Program does not have regulatory environmental monitoring clearance for its sediment recovery perimeter.
